note: Starter mapping from NVIDIA XID codes to SLA actions. Review it against NVIDIA's XID documentation for your driver version and against the contract before using it for SLA decisions. node_down opens an incident that stays open until an up event arrives from a repair or health-check integration.

13.summary: Graphics engine exception; usually caused by the application

31.summary: GPU memory page fault; usually caused by the application

43.summary: GPU stopped processing; usually caused by the application

45.summary: Preemptive cleanup after a process ended

63.summary: Row remapping or page retirement recorded; schedule a GPU reset

64.summary: Row remapping or page retirement failed

79.summary: GPU has fallen off the bus

94.summary: Contained ECC error; restart the application

default.summary: Not in the policy; needs a human decision
